oeuvres.titre: Saikyou Onna Shishou-tachi ga Ikusei Houshin o Megutte Shuraba
oeuvres.synopsis: There are three female masters who are known to be the strongest in the world. The only thing they can't get their hands on... their ideal man. "If there are no ideal men, why not raise one ourselves!?" As they skim over the list of candidates, the ladies' eyes all fixate on one boy. A level 0 with no shred of talent... ___ **Character Designer:** [Tajima Ryuushi](https://mangadex.org/author/3ac15f57-6a12-4018-b549-30aab86fc6c8)

oeuvres.titre: Saikyou Tank no Meikyuu Kouryaku ~Tairyoku 9999 no Rare Skill-mochi Tank, Yuusha Party wo Tsuihou Sareru~
oeuvres.synopsis: Rud is a tank of the Hero's Party and is said to have the highest defense ever in history. The party often does labyrinth raids, but to Rud, it means more than just a raid. To cure his beloved sister's illness, he is in search for the wish-granting treasure that might be hidden in those labyrinths. But one day, the arrogant hero kicks him from the party after an unsuccessful raid attempt, blaming it on his skills whose effects he is still unaware of. Without nowhere else to go and nothing to do, he decides to return to his hometown, where his sister is waiting. On his way there, he saves a gir

oeuvres.titre: Sakamoto Days
oeuvres.synopsis: Taro Sakamoto est un assassin légendaire, le meilleur d'entre tous, craint par tous les gangsters, adulé par ses pairs. Mais un beau jour... il tombe amoureux ! S'ensuivent retraite, mariage, paternité... et prise de poids. Sakamoto est aujourd'hui patron d'une petite épicerie de quartier et coule des jours heureux avec sa famille. Mais lorsque son passé le rattrape sous les traits de Shin, un jeune assassin télépathe, Sakamoto reprend du service... Et malgré son apparence, il est toujours aussi charismatique lorsqu'il passe à l'action !

oeuvres.titre: Sakurai-san wa Kizuite Hoshii
oeuvres.synopsis: Makoto spends his afternoons at the classroom, lazying around, studying… That is, provided that his beautiful and enticing friend and classmate Sakurai is not around. Is she coming on to him? Is she saying what he thinks she's saying? Is he allowed to read between the lines? Let's see if Makoto gets the big picture she's painting for him!

oeuvres.titre: Salaryman ga Isekai ni Ittara Shitennou ni Natta Hanashi
oeuvres.synopsis: Dennosuke Uchimura is a simple Salaryman, who one day is run over by an elderly lady on a scooter and left in the street to die. When he regained consciousness he discovers he was summoned to another world by the Demon King himself, who offers him a position as one of his Four Heavenly Kings. Can Dennosuke survive as a servant of the Demon King, and meet his expectations?

oeuvres.titre: Sasayaku You ni Koi wo Utau
oeuvres.synopsis: Himari est une lycéenne de première année qui, dès le premier jour, assiste à la représentation du club de musique au gymnase de l'école. Elle a eu le coup de foudre pour la chanteuse Yori, à qui elle s'est déclarée devant les casiers du lycée. En cherchant ledit élève plus tard, elle découvre qu'elle ne fait pas vraiment partie du club et qu'elle aime jouer de la musique seule sur le toit. Là, elle découvre que Yori aussi est tombée amoureuse d'elle.

oeuvres.titre: Sayounara Ryuusei, Konnichiwa Jinsei
oeuvres.synopsis: The strongest and oldest dragon who had lived through eternity allowed himself to be killed by Hero. Just as he prepared for eternal sleep, he realized himself reborn as Dran, a villager in the frontier. Working the field, hunting forest animal, and having a warm life has filled his heart with joy he never experienced in his whole dragon life. One day, when he's patrolling the forest near his village, he encountered a powerful demon army.

oeuvres.titre: Second Life Ranker
oeuvres.synopsis: Yeon-woo avait un frère jumeau qui a disparu il y a cinq ans. Un jour, une montre de poche laissée par son frère est retournée en sa possession. À l'intérieur, il a trouvé un journal intime caché dans lequel on pouvait lire : "Le temps que tu entendes ceci, je serai déjà mort…". l'Obélisque, la Tour du Dieu Soleil, un monde où plusieurs univers et dimensions se croisent. Dans ce monde, son frère avait été victime d'une trahison en montant la tour. Après avoir appris la vérité, Yeon-woo décida d'escalader la tour avec le journal de son frère. Yeon-woo passe ensuite par les mêmes épreuves que so

oeuvres.titre: Seijo no Maryoku wa Bannou desu
oeuvres.synopsis: Sei, une accro au travail, se retrouve invoquée par erreur dans un autre monde lors d'un rituel qui a pour but d'invoquer une Sainte qui pourra éradiquer tous les démons. Après son arrivée, seule l'autre jeune fille invoquée en même temps est emmenée voir le Prince. Après avoir quitté le palais, Sei commence à travailler dans un laboratoire de recherches et découvre cette nouvelle vie. --- [Official English Novel](https://sevenseasentertainment.com/series/the-saints-magic-power-is-omnipotent-light-novel/) **Wikipedia:** * [English](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Saint%27s_Magic_Power_Is_Omn

oeuvres.titre: Seiken Gakuin no Maken Tsukai
oeuvres.synopsis: In the fantasy story, the demon king Leonis sealed himself away for 1,000 years in order to prepare for the final battle, but when he woke up, he found himself in the body of a 10-year-old boy. A beautiful young woman named Lisellia from the Holy Sword Academy then says to him, "Why were you locked up in such a place? It's OK now, this big sister will take care of you!" Under Lisellia's care, Leonis is shocked to see that the world has completely changed. Bewildered and confused, Leonis finds himself enrolling at the Holy Sword Academy.

oeuvres.titre: Seirei Gensouki ~Konna Sekai de Deaeta Kimi ni~
oeuvres.synopsis: Amakawa Haruto est un jeune homme mort avant de retrouver son ami d'enfance disparu il y a cinq ans. Rio est un garçon vivant dans les bidonvilles qui veut venger sa mère qui a été assassinée devant lui quand il avait cinq ans. La Terre et un autre monde. Deux personnes d'horizons et de valeurs complètement différents. Pour une raison quelconque, les souvenirs et la personnalité d'Haruto qui aurait dû mourir sont ressuscités dans le corps de Rio. Comme les deux se confondent sur leurs souvenirs et leurs personnalités fusionnant ensemble, Rio (Haruto) décide de vivre dans ce nouveau monde. Avec

oeuvres.titre: Sekai de Tada Hitori no Mamonotsukai: Tenshoku shitara Maou ni Machigawaremashita
oeuvres.synopsis: After searching for a long time, Noah finally found the [Divine Job Tome]. With it, he just might be able to get away from his current Divine Job [Hero] and its responsibility! Or so he thought. Because the new job that had been granted to him, [Monster Tamer] was completely unheard of…!?

oeuvres.titre: Sekai de Yuuitsu no Tenshokushi: Job Hopper na Ore wa, Isekai de Subete no Job o Kiwameru Koto ni Shita
oeuvres.synopsis: Tsukasa, a company employee who repeatedly changes jobs in search of better conditions, challenges the final interview of a major corporation. But as soon as he went past the door, he found himself in another world. His past career seems completely irrelevant, leading to a sense of discouragement. But, the "Job Changer" bestowed upon him grants him a unique ability!With the power to freely switch between jobs like swordsman, mage, spear user, alchemist, appraiser, pharmacist, and more, he begins a leisurely life in this different world. Whether dealing with monsters or making use of abundant k

oeuvres.titre: Sekai no Owari no Encore
oeuvres.synopsis: À la fin de la Guerre de la Fin, le Héros vaillant, Elline, laissa derrière lui un trésor inestimable, l’Encore, archive contenant tout de ce monde, de sa création à sa réincarnation. Les pays du monde envoyèrent des équipes d’aventuriers à la recherche de l’Encore, et formèrent la jeunesse pour leur futur. Ren E. Maxwell, un épéiste en devenir sans talent, est moqué par tous ces camarades : copie conforme d’Elline, il est appelé le Faux héros vaillant. Un jour cependant, il fit la rencontre de Kylse, ancienne équipière d’Elline. Celle-ci le confond alors avec Elline… La légende du Faux héros

oeuvres.titre: Sekai Saikou no Ansatsusha, Isekai Kizoku ni Tensei Suru
oeuvres.synopsis: The most dangerous prey... When the most accomplished assassin on Earth meets his end just before retirement, he finds himself standing before a goddess. Her world is headed for disaster, and she has need of his particular set of skills. Armed with powerful new abilities and decades of deadly knowledge, he begins his second life as Lugh, young scion of the Tuatha Dé clan of assassins. His mission: to find and eliminate the strongest individual in this world-the hero! *Source: Yen Press, Vol. 1*

oeuvres.titre: Sekai Saikyou no Kouei ~Meikyuukoku no Shinjin Tansakusha~
oeuvres.synopsis: Workaholic assistant Atobe Arihito fell asleep in his company's bus that was traveling for a vacation. When he awoke he learned he had died due to the bus getting into an accident, and that he had reincarnated into a world of reincarnators - to the Labyrinth Country. To his surprise he was discovered by his slave driving manager, Igarashi Kyouka, who further explains their role in this world. In Labyrinth Country, Reincarnators are expected to choose a job and form parties to fight against monsters in Labyrinths. "Valkyrie" Kyouka had expected Arihito to work with her once again, but he declin

oeuvres.titre: Sengoku Komachi Kuroutan
oeuvres.synopsis: Shizuko est une lycéenne ordinaire avec des intérêts extraordinaires : l'Histoire et l'agricutlure. Ces passions vont peut-être lui sauver la vie : projetée à la période Sengoku, elle se retrouve au service d'un seigneur excentrique et exigeant : le fameux Oda Nobunaga. Obsédé par l'idée d'unifier le pays en proie aux guerres intestines, il entend bien faire usage des étranges compétences de cette fille venue d'ailleurs. Shizuko parviendra-t-elle à gagner sa confiance ? Retournera-t-elle à son époque ?

oeuvres.titre: Senken no Majutsushi to Yobareta Kenshi
oeuvres.synopsis: L'épée magique, où une épée est manipulée en utilisant la magie pour voler librement dans les airs, en abattant les ennemis. Ardis est un utilisateur de ce nouvel art magique qui n'a jamais été vu auparavant dans toute l'histoire de la magie. En tant que mercenaire, il entreprend diverses demandes en échange d'une rémunération, y compris des subjugations, des escortes et des enquêtes. Sur le chemin du retour après une demande d'enquête, il protège une paire de jumelles qui ont survécu à leur caravane attaquée par des bandits, mais dans ce monde les jumelles sont considérées comme des "abominat

oeuvres.titre: Senpai ga Uzai Kouhai no Hanashi
oeuvres.synopsis: Futaba Igarashi est une petite employée de bureau qui trouve que son imposant et turbulent collègue Harumi Takeda lui met toujours des bâtons dans les roues, mais il la soutient toujours, il lui tient toujours compagnie, et elle commence à remarquer que son cœur est lentement en train de pencher vers lui...

oeuvres.titre: Sensei wa Koi o Oshierarenai
oeuvres.synopsis: A lazy student and a straight-laced teacher. At first glance, they seem like they are on bad terms, but things get different after classes...

oeuvres.titre: Sensitive Boy
oeuvres.synopsis: Stories of bittersweet youth, about troubled boys facing coming-of-age questions about love, sexuality, and other psychological issues.

oeuvres.titre: Sentai Daishikkaku
oeuvres.synopsis: Il y a 13 ans, un château flottant est apparu à 1000 mètres au-dessus du sol et une armée maléfique est venue dans le but d'envahir l'humanité. Afin de protéger l'humanité contre ces envahisseurs, des super-héros se battent, mais les choses ne semblent pas être comme elles le paraissent !

oeuvres.titre: Sentouin, Hakenshimasu!
oeuvres.synopsis: The Secret Society Kisaragi has one mission: world domination! They claim to be an evil organization, but their scientist is eccentric, their hot female generals wear little clothing, and they’re surprisingly concerned about the fate of the world!? No. 6 is a Combatant for Kisaragi, meaning his body has been reconstructed to be stronger and obey the orders of the generals. His latest mission? To do recon on an unknown alien planet with his new partner, the deadpan android Alice. There, he meets a busty female knight... riding a unicorn!?

oeuvres.titre: Serial Killer Isekai ni Oritatsu
oeuvres.synopsis: A murderer who can't stop the urge to kill people, even though he wants to stop, is happy when his desired death sentence is carried out - only to be reincarnated into another world. The mission entrusted to him by the goddess was to kill 12 reincarnated people using his murderous impulses! Not all reincarnated people are saints! ___ **Notes:** - With the debut of the spinoff series, it was revealed that Hitotsubu Ichigo (the credited author) was actually an alias of Kawamoto Homura. Starting with Volume 5, the credited author is Kawamoto Homura. - Won the Rakuten Kobo Ebook Award 2024 Special

oeuvres.titre: Sewayaki Kitsune no Senko-san
oeuvres.synopsis: Like many hardworking members of the workforce, Kuroto Nakano is perpetually stressed out by his job. Still, since he lives alone, he must carry on to sustain himself. Little do humans like Kuroto know, this stress takes the form of darkness residing within a person's body and will bring one's life to ruin. Fox deities can see this darkness and have the duty to save people before it is too late. To help rid Kuroto of his stress, Senko-san, an eight hundred-year-old foxgirl, volunteers to take care of him, and will do everything she can to ease the tension in his weary soul. --- **Notes:** - De

oeuvres.titre: Shachiku Succubus no Hanashi
oeuvres.synopsis: Meet Lily. As a succubus, she is tasked with finding men every day, taking control of their dreams to steal their vitality. In return, Lily will fulfill any desires they have, no matter how perverted they are. And as the succubi population rate decreases, Lily finds herself more and more overworked in order to reach her rising quota. One day, she enters the domicile of an exhausted corporate drone. Lily promises to make the man's wildest dreams come true, but what he asks for shocks her.

oeuvres.titre: Shachou to Sake to Hoshi
oeuvres.synopsis: Reina Izutsu, 24 ans, vient de reprendre la direction de l’imprimerie familiale après la disparition soudaine de son père. Mais endosser ce rôle n’a rien d’évident… et ses employés en font les frais. Kenichi Ishizumi, 37 ans, chef de service discret et loyal, s’inquiète pour elle. Un soir, il la croise par hasard dans un parc. Ivre et à bout de nerfs, Reina explose : “J’en peux plus ! J’arrête d’être présidente !” Sans même réaliser qu’elle parle à un de ses subordonnés, elle se livre entièrement… Sous les étoiles, une promesse silencieuse naît. Kenichi décide de la soutenir, peu importe ce qu

oeuvres.titre: Shihai Shoujo Kubaru-chan
oeuvres.synopsis: After fierce bullying, Yuuto Kiba wanted to die. On the verge of committing suicide, his fate changes rapidly when a strange and funky beautiful girl, Kubaru, tells him, “Give me your life”. Make your life happy with love?! A slightly strange and psycho love drama.

oeuvres.titre: Shijou Saikyou no Daimaou, Murabito A ni Tensei Suru
oeuvres.synopsis: **“Here I come, a life full of friendship!”** What would happen if the mightiest being of all time reincarnates himself as Villager A? As the Demon Lord, Varvatos leads a life where nobody dares intrude in his personal space. Desperate to find friends, he takes matters into his own hands and reincarnates 3000 years later as Ard Meteor, your regular nobody born in the boonies. But little did he know, magic has vastly degenerated after his passing, and what was considered average magic power during his lifetime is now considered never-before-seen talent! In a new life as a new abnormal, will he

oeuvres.titre: Shijou Saikyou no Mahou Kenshi, F Rank Boukensha ni Tensei Suru ~Kensei to Matei, 2 Tsu no Zense wo motta Otoko no Eiyuutan~
oeuvres.synopsis: Yuri, the hero who saved the world, was called the Demon Emperor in his first reincarnation and the Sword Saint in his second. However he was considered a monster, and shunned by the people. Yuri finally grows tired of this and resolves to live 100% for himself next time. He reincarnates once again in the world of the future. Immediately after his reincarnation, monsters start attacking him. As he quickly responds, Yuri acquires skills from his previous lives one after another, and annihilates the enemies in no time. Yuri eventually makes it to the guild, and while he possesses the ultimate po

oeuvres.titre: Shikkaku-mon no Saikyou Kenja ~Sekai Saikyou no Kenja ga Sarani Tsuyoku Naru Tame ni Tensei Shimashita~
oeuvres.synopsis: Dans un certain monde, vivait un homme qui excellait dans les combats magiques, les gens l'appelaient [Sage]. Cherchant la plus puissante magie de combat, il dévoua sa vie à rechercher toutes les magies et arts du combat existant. Mais la conclusion à laquelle il parvint fut cruel, [Mon corps n'est pas fait pour la magie de combat]. Pourtant il n'abandonna pas. Il scella son âme grâce à un art magique, et se réincarna à une lointaine époque. Les connaissances magiques de ce monde complètement différentes étaient à ses yeux incroyablement faible.

oeuvres.titre: Shimotsuki-san wa Mobu ga Suki: Hitomishiri na Kanojo wa Ore ni Dake Dere Amai
oeuvres.synopsis: "Only you are special." After school, Koutarou Nakayama returns to school to pick up something he forgot and finds Shiho Shimotsuki asleep in an empty classroom. Shiho is rumored to be Ryouma Ryuuzaki's crush, a popular boy who has formed a harem in his class, but she is always expressionless and no one has ever seen her smile. But now, her fair skin is holding Koutarou's hand...?!

oeuvres.titre: Shin no Jitsuryoku wa Girigiri made Kakushiteiyou to Omou
oeuvres.synopsis: Un monde où l'on peut conclure un pacte avec les dieux et acquérir des compétences. Troisième fils d'une célèbre famille de chevaliers, Yuno était tellement occupé à contrôler son pouvoir inné qu'il a fini par être qualifié d'"incompétent"... Cependant, à l'académie des chevaliers magiques, où il était inscrit pour une raison quelconque, il a fait la rencontre fatidique d'un dieu sans nom qui était méprisé pour son "incompétence"... Yuno, qui a conclu un pacte avec la déesse et l'a nommée [Athéna], a secrètement décidé de faire d'elle le dieu suprême, et a décidé d'être un peu plus sérieuse.

oeuvres.titre: Shingeki no Eroko-san: Hen na Oneesan wa Danshi Kousei to Nakayoku Naritai
oeuvres.synopsis: Shindou Eruko, a glasses, big breasted beauty, found a job as a handyman for the Amaguri Handyman service after her NEET life comes to an end as her savings ran out. She immediately falls for her co-worker Hoshi-kun on their first day working together, but there's a problem: Hoshi-kun is a high school boy, while Eruko is a 27 years old onee-san who has trouble telling reality and delusions apart. She ends up constantly scheming to get close to Hoshi-kun to turn many of her delusions into reality, but after several near-misses, it became apparent to Eruko that Hoshi-kun does, indeed, have feeli

oeuvres.titre: Shinigami Bocchan to Kuro Maid
oeuvres.synopsis: In a large mansion lives a boy, an aristocrat who was cursed by the witch to "let everything he touches die." With him is his maid Alice, who besides serving him, likes to tease him. The boy who is interested in her doesn't mind the teasing, but not being able to touch her is painful! If they are unable to hold hands, how will their love ever bloom?

oeuvres.titre: Shinigami ni Sodaterareta Shoujo wa Shikkoku no Tsurugi o Mune ni Idaku
oeuvres.synopsis: Olivia is just a baby when the mysterious Z finds her at a temple in the depths of the Forest of No Return. From that day on, the temple becomes her home and Z her family. Z, a god of death, educates her in the ways of the world, in combat, and in the long-forgotten arts of magic—right up until the day Z disappears. Olivia leaves the forest for the first time in search of Z with its ebony blade in hand. Out in the wider world, all is not well. A bitter war rages between the Asvelt Empire and the Kingdom of Fernest, and Fernest is losing badly. When Olivia shows up on Fernest's doorstep with a

oeuvres.titre: Shinjiteita Nakamatachi ni Dungeon Okuchi de Korosarekaketa ga Gift "Mugen Gacha" de Level 9999 no Nakamatachi wo Te ni Irete Moto Party Member to Sekai ni Fukushuu & "Zamaa!" Shimasu!
oeuvres.synopsis: There are six races in this world: human, beast, dragon, elf, dwarf, and demon. Humans are discriminated against and looked down on as the most inferior race. The "Gathering of Races" was a party with members from each race gathered to dispel such discrimination, but they also had a hidden purpose. They were ordered by the non-human countries to search for the human "Master," and take it to their own country. Light, a human boy with the gift "Infinite Gacha," was welcomed into the Gathering of Races as he was suspected of being a Master. But in the end, their investigation showed that Light wa

oeuvres.titre: Shiou no Kikan: Moto Yuusha no Ore, Jibun ga Soshiki Shita Chuuni Himitsu Kessha o Tomeru tame ni Futatabi Isekai ni Shoukan Sareteshimau
oeuvres.synopsis: "How can my past self get so excited doing all those embarrassing things?!" When he was in the third year of middle school, Hizaki Shiou was summoned to another world to save it. After defeating the Demon King, he was forcibly returned back to the present day. Yet another three years later, he is summoned to the other world once again, this time to stop the rampage of the secret society "Helheim." That organization was supposedly actually the one that he had founded during his *chuunibyou* phase, where he called himself the "Corpse King"—a dark past too embarrassing to remember! Someone seems

oeuvres.titre: Shitsugyou Kenja no Nariagari: Kirawareta Sainou wa Sekai Saikyou deshita
oeuvres.synopsis: Karna was a boy that was given the title of "Wise man" from heaven, is scouted by the hero party that had great expectations for his skills. However, his job of "necromancer" was creepy and he was immediately exiled. Karna, who got lost on the road without getting a reward, had accidentally invaded the Demon Lord's territory and was targeted by the demons! Karna faced a demon with a mighty power, but defeats it with magic that overwhemed it by far. A fearsome demon. Meanwhile, Cecilia the demon, who saw the whole scene, offers Karna a large annual salary. And Karna decided to become an enemy o

oeuvres.titre: Shiunji-ke no Kodomotachi
oeuvres.synopsis: The love between brother and sister. The love between man and woman. That which is most forbidden is most unyielding. The two sons and five daughters of the Shiunji family shine like brilliant gems, each with intelligence and beauty in equal measure. And with the pedigree of their wealthy father behind them, how could they not be the talk of the town? Eldest son Arata has spent his life being tossed around by the whims of his colorful sisters, yet a little teasing won't stop him from valuing his family over anything and anyone else. But when his youngest sister turns fifteen, their father reve

oeuvres.titre: Shokei Sareta Kenja wa Lich ni Tensei Shite Shinryaku-sensou o Hajimeru
oeuvres.synopsis: The Sage Dwight, along with the Hero, defeated the Demon Lord who sank the world into darkness. However, they were falsely accused of becoming the next Demon Lords because of his power, and were thrown to The Valley of the Dead to die... But though his flesh has rotten away, he lives on as a skeleton because of his grudge against the world. Dwight has vowed to deny that wrong world, and with a power that surpasses even the Demon King of the past, and also leading countless Skeletons he's going to start an all out war...!

oeuvres.titre: Shoukan Sareta Kenja wa Isekai wo Yuku ~Saikyou na no wa Fuyou Zaiko no Aitemu deshita~
oeuvres.synopsis: Touya, the strongest player in the game Pandemic World Online, had won so many items that he decided to create an alternate account to store the extra ones. While playing this very game in his second account, he was summoned to another world as a character he made, where the people were merrily expecting a hero! However, when it's revealed that he doesn't have the title of a hero, he is discarded and replaced by another person. Now, he must survive in an another world with the account he merely used to store his extra items in.

oeuvres.titre: Shounen no Abyss
oeuvres.synopsis: Dans une ville vide, au milieu d'une vie quotidienne répétitive, Reiji Kurose, lycéen, ne faisait que " vivre". Sa famille, ses rêves d'avenir, ses amis d'enfance. Tous ces éléments le liaient à cette ville. Il pensait qu'il continuerait "juste" à vivre jusqu'à la fin, jusqu'à ce qu'il la rencontre. Y a-t-il de l'espoir dans la vie ? Y a-t-il de la lumière dans l'avenir ? C'est le début d'une série de rencontres entre garçons et filles qui reflète le présent!

oeuvres.titre: Shounin Yuusha wa Isekai o Gyuujiru!: Saibai Skill de Nandemo Fuyashichaimasu!
oeuvres.synopsis: A hero with a production skill?? Akina Shoji, a salary slave, had a dream to open his own business. However, When he almost made his dream come true, He’s been summoned into another world with a “Cultivation” skill…

oeuvres.titre: Shukuteki no Ie no Toushu o Tsuma ni Moraimashita: Tsuma wa Karen de Hakanakute Yasashikute Kashikokute Kawaikute Saikou desu
oeuvres.synopsis: The Fors family is a prestigious lineage of swordsmen and a prominent noble house ruling the southern domain of the kingdom. Born as their third son, Nova endured a harsh childhood, branded a failure due to his utter inability to wield the exclusive power inherent to their bloodline. Even after reaching adulthood and being granted a small territory, he is burdened with virtually zero duties and zero expectations from his family and the people around him. However, an unexpected marriage proposal finds its way to Nova. The other party belongs to a great noble house that rules the northern domain

oeuvres.titre: Shut Up, Malevolent Dragon! I Don’t Want to Have Any More Children With You
oeuvres.synopsis: After being defeated and captured, the dragon slayer Leon became a captive of the Silver Dragon Queen. With the awareness of death, he used forbidden magic to curse the queen, but unexpectedly, the queen lost control. He thought that this would make the queen live with shame for the rest of her life, and it would be worthy of the dragon slayer's mission. But two years later, when Leon opened his eyes, next to him was a little dragon girl with a tail...

oeuvres.titre: Shuu ni Ichido Classmate wo Kau Hanashi: Futari no Jikan, Iiwake no 5000-en
oeuvres.synopsis: Once a week, Miyagi pays 5,000 yen to her classmate Sendai. The 5,000 yen is to buy three hours of Sendai's time, which gives the right for Miyagi to give her orders. Miyagi is at the bottom of the school caste while Sendai is at the top. The two, who never crossed paths at school, spend time together after school under such a contract. Miyagi's orders are determined by her mood of the day, and Sendai cannot disobey. One day after school... Miyagi calls Sendai to her room and gives her an order that she usually does not give.

oeuvres.titre: Shuukatsu Shippai shita Succubus-san wo Hiroimashita
oeuvres.synopsis: Man brings home succubus, doesn’t get fucked. Instead, gets a cute succubus to take care of him.

oeuvres.titre: Shuumatsu no Valkyrie
oeuvres.synopsis: Tous les mille ans, l'ensemble des dieux, tous panthéons réunis, se réunissent au Valhalla, le paradis des âmes, lors d'une assemblée présidée par Zeus, le dieu suprême grec, afin de décider du sort des humains. Or, cette année-là, il est décidé à la quasi-unanimité de détruire l'humanité. Mais la Valkyrie Brunehilde interrompt la conférence et propose aux dieux de se mesurer aux mortels lors du tournoi de Ragnarök, pour déterminer s'ils valent vraiment la peine d'êtres anéantis. Ce tournoi opposera 13 dieux issus de diverses mythologies à 13 puissants humains qui ont fait l'histoire. Si l'hum

oeuvres.titre: Shy
oeuvres.synopsis: Au milieu du XXIe siècle, le monde était au bord de la troisième guerre mondiale. Mais des super-héros du monde entier sont apparus et ont contribué à l'avènement d'une ère de paix. La crise ayant été évitée, les Héros sont retournés dans leur pays d'origine où ils apportent désormais leur aide pour les affaires intérieures. C'est l'histoire de la jeune héroïne japonaise nommée « Shy »… --- Maison d'édition FR : **Kana**

oeuvres.titre: Slime Seijo
oeuvres.synopsis: Il était une fois un slime qui souhaitait devenir humain. Un jour, il rencontra un congénère ayant l'apparence d'une humaine et qui lui expliqua sa méthode : trouver un cadavre frais d'humain, et remplacer son sang par son corps de slime ! Le réceptacle qu'il trouve est finalement celui de Jelly, une jeune fille de la noblesse ayant des pouvoirs de Sainte. Fort malheureusement, celle-ci avait un horrible caractère et menait la vie dure a ses serviteurs, ce qui entraîna son assassinat. Pour vivre sa vie idéale d'humain, le slime n'a maintenant d'autre choix que de remplacer Jelly et de reconstr

oeuvres.titre: Sokushi Cheat ga Saikyou Sugite, Isekai no Yatsura ga Marude Aite ni Naranai ndesu ga. -ΑΩ-
oeuvres.synopsis: Growth cheats? Infinite magic power? The ability to utilize all archetypes? What’s the point if instant death ends everything with a single attack? Awaking to absolute chaos and carnage while on a school trip, Yogiri Takatou discovers that everyone in his class has been transported to another world! He had somehow managed to sleep through the entire ordeal himself, missing out on the Gift — powers bestowed upon the others by a mysterious Sage who appeared to transport them. Even worse, he and another classmate were ruthlessly abandoned by their friends, left as bait to distract a nearby dragon

oeuvres.titre: Solo Leveling
oeuvres.synopsis: Lorsque d’étranges portails sont apparus aux quatre coins du monde, l’humanité a dû trouver parade pour ne pas finir massacrée entre les griffes des monstres qu’ils ont apportés avec eux. La solution ? Les chasseurs ! Ces combattants intrépides n’hésitent pas à foncer au cœur des donjons dimensionnels pour combattre les créatures qu’ils abritent, et y collecter des trésors. --- - [1st Trailer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hLwQUZgFiM4) | [ENG](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SP5TdrbsePE) | [JP](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lY82MjIM99o) - [2nd Trailer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JRXcb

oeuvres.titre: Solo Leveling: Ragnarok
oeuvres.synopsis: After witnessing the death of one of their own, the Absolute Ones — creators of the many universes outside of our own — frantically seek to fill the power void left by their fallen brother. With earth's existence in danger once more as gates spill monsters into our dimension, Sung Suho must answer the call and conquer the shadow dungeon while learning of his father's legendary legacy.

oeuvres.titre: Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi o Suru
oeuvres.synopsis: Wakana Gojo est un lycéen solitaire. Son rêve est de devenir artisan et de fabriquer les poupées traditionnelles pour le Hina Matsuri. Mais comme cette passion n’est pas très virile, il la cache et ne se fait pas remarquer. Jusqu’au jour ou Marine Kitagawa, la fille la plus populaire du lycée, le voit se servir d’une machine à coudre ! Contre toute attente elle lui demande de devenir son couturier pour réaliser… des tenues de cosplay ! --- Maison d'édition FR : **Kana**

oeuvres.titre: Sono Mono. Nochi ni… ~Kigatsuitara S-kyuu Saikyou!? Yuusha Wazu no Daibouken~
oeuvres.synopsis: Wazu was an ordinary townsman who shut himself off in the mountain because of an unfortunate course of events. After 2 years, he decided to come down from the mountain to meet with people. But there were various misunderstanding about the mountain which he shut himself off in. And then he repeatedly had encounters with people. And after that… ___ **Character Designer:** [Miya Kazutomo](https://mangadex.org/author/5453ee76-b190-4c0d-8d69-78513aba5519)

oeuvres.titre: Sore wa Rei no Shiwaza desu
oeuvres.synopsis: Je m'appelle Torii Nozomi. Un jour, une nouvelle fille est arrivée dans ma classe. Elle est très jolie, mais le problème c'est qu'elle est suivie par un fantôme (très taquin) que je suis le seul à voir !

oeuvres.titre: Soredemo Ayumu wa Yosetekuru
oeuvres.synopsis: Ayumu n'avouera ses sentiments à sa senpai que s'il la bat dans une partie de Shougi. Bien que le jour de la victoire semble très très loin, il va essayer de gagner par bien d'autres moyens.

oeuvres.titre: Sousou no Frieren
oeuvres.synopsis: Que deviennent les héros une fois le mal vaincu ? Dans ce coffret collector : un jeu de 54 cartes entièrement personnalisé aux couleurs de la série et le manga avec une jaquette alternative réversible ! Alors que Frieren et ses compagnons font halte dans la citadelle de Heiß, Stark propose à Fern d'aller en rendez-vous, sur le ton de la plaisanterie... et contre toute attente, la jeune fille accepte ! Sur les conseils de l'elfe, qui n'y connaît pas grand-chose, le guerrier emmène donc son amie faire le tour de la ville, ce qui leur permet de se rapprocher un peu. Après cette pause bienvenue, l

oeuvres.titre: Souzai Saishuka no Isekai Ryokouki
oeuvres.synopsis: Takeru Kamishiro is a normal guy with an ordinary office job, but one day finds himself summoned to another world. Takeru starts his new life in "Madeus", a world with swords and magic, fully equipped with multiple skills! Not only does he have enhanced physical and amazing magic abilities, but also the power to "search" for valuable items. With the cheat skills he's been provided, Takeru starts his new adventure in the new world!!

oeuvres.titre: SPY×FAMILY
oeuvres.synopsis: The master spy codenamed has spent most of his life on undercover missions, all for the dream of a better world. Yet one day he receives a particularly difficult order from command. For his mission, he must form a temporary family and start a new life?!

oeuvres.titre: SSS-Class Revival Hunter
oeuvres.synopsis: In the mysterious, RPG dungeon-like Tower, Gongja Kim lives a mundane existence, envying all the star hunters. One day, his wish for more is granted with a legendary skill to copy others’ abilities… at the cost of his life. Before he can make sense of it, he’s killed by the #1 hunter, the Flame Emperor! But this activates his skill and now he’s copied a new one, the ability to travel back in time upon death. How will Gongja use these skills to outplay the competition and rise to the top?

oeuvres.titre: Suki na Ko ga Megane wo Wasureta
oeuvres.synopsis: Entre eux deux, c’est l’amour flou ! Mie, la voisine de classe de Komura, a oublié ses lunettes. Encore. Déjà troublé rien qu’en la voyant le jeune homme fait de son mieux pour aider sa camarade tête en l’air.Mais, dans un effort désespéré d’y voir plus clair, Mie se retrouve très près de lui… beaucoup trop près ! Komura ne sait plus comment réagir à cette soudaine proximité. Au propre comme au figuré, c’est l’occasion pour lui de se rapprocher !

oeuvres.titre: Super no Ura de Yani Suu Futari
oeuvres.synopsis: Sasaki, an overworked salaryman, goes through an average stressful day just for a single light at the end of the tunnel: Yamada, the always-cheerful clerk at his favorite convenience store. One day, Sasaki takes an extra amount of time at a company meeting, and by the time he gets to the convenience store Yamada has already clocked out. However, as he leaves, he notices a young woman with piercings smoking behind the store? ___ Alt. Official English: [Square Enix (vol.)](https://squareenixmangaandbooks.square-enix-games.com/en-us/series/smoking-behind-the-supermarket-with-you)

oeuvres.titre: Taida na Akujoku Kizoku ni Tensei shita Ore, Scenario wo Bukkowashitara Kikakugai no Maryoku de Saikyou ni Natta
oeuvres.synopsis: I don't know how it happened, but somehow I've died and reincarnated into my favorite academy game. And if that wasn't weird enough, I'm now the depraved and lazy villain, Weiss Fansent, whose misdeeds lead him to a deadly end. Something I'm determined to avoid at all costs. With little time left until the academy's entrance exams, I have no choice but to dive headfirst into serious and grueling training. Which means swordsmanship with the S-rank adventurer Miruku Abitas, followed by intense magic practice. It was demanding and exhausting, but getting stronger means I have a better chance of a

oeuvres.titre: Takarakuji de 40-oku Atatta ndakedo Isekai ni Ijuu Suru
oeuvres.synopsis: After winning a 4 Billion Yen lottery, I quit my company job. But I ended up in a different world doing some serious volunteering, saving a poor village with contemporary Japanese materials and technology from the home center. What would happen if I bring modern home electrical appliances over there from Japan? And it seems I would fall in love with a beautiful girl in the village. ___ Original Character Designer: [Kurojishi](https://mangadex.org/author/5b735c65-e596-49db-8f9f-e26141a65003/kurojishi)

oeuvres.titre: Takou no Koori Hime wo Tasuketara, Otomodachi kara Hajimeru Koto ni Narimashita
oeuvres.synopsis: Nagi Shinonome, known as the "Ice Princess," is a beautiful girl with a cold attitude who does not allow others to get close to her. One day, Souta Minori, who saw her being molested on the train, saved her with all his courage, but the next day she appeared again and said, "I want you to stay by my side." Can Souta continue as friends with the Ice Princess, who only sweetly melts for one person in the world, that is, himself?

oeuvres.titre: Tearmoon Teikoku Monogatari ~Dantoudai kara Hajimaru, Hime no Tensei Gyakuten Story~
oeuvres.synopsis: In the Tearmoon Empire, the disdained selfish princess Mia was sentenced to death – or at least, she was supposed to have been! Instead, she woke up as her twelve-year-old self?? To avoid the guillotine in her second life, she won't repeat her past failures... "F-For me, something of this level is an easy task!" Ultimate self-defense! Strongest self-awareness! Using her previously clumsy, timid princess image, she will go against fate- a once-in-a-lifetime fantasy of fixing history!

oeuvres.titre: Tedama ni Toritai Kurokiya-san
oeuvres.synopsis: Kurokiya Ruu is on the verge of repeating a year, and in an attempt to fix her grades, her teachers get a top student to tutor her: Tadashi Tadao (name literally translates to *straight-forward man*), who happens to be her childhood friend who she hasn't seen since they went to different middle schools. However, they end up not getting any studying done as she uses this situation to try and seduce him at every turn. This is the story of a girl who wants to get her crush flustered and lead him around by his nose, and a straight-forward guy who won't get embarrassed.

oeuvres.titre: Teenage Mercenary
oeuvres.synopsis: Ijin est un jeune mercenaire qui est le seul survivant d’un accident d’avion survenu dans son enfance. Il vient tout juste de retourner auprès de sa famille qui le croyait mort durant ses 10 ans d’absence. Ijin pourra-t-il mettre de côté son passé sombre et mener une vie normale de lycéen? --- **Original Webtoon:** [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=5611024), [Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=758150) **Official Translations:** * [English](https://www.webtoons.com/en/action/teenage-mercenary/list?title_no=2677) * [Chinese (Simplified

oeuvres.titre: Teisou Gyakuten Sekai Nara Moteru to Omotte Itara
oeuvres.synopsis: "A World Where Chastity is Reversed"—A dream world where the male-to-female ratio is 1:20, women have stronger sexual desires, and precious men live a smooth life protected by their bodyguards. Ikuto laments that it must be because his bodyguards are all handsome men, and especially his childhood friend Rui Toosaka, who is particularly high-spec... but in reality, the bodyguards are beautiful girls disguised as men! Completely unaware,

oeuvres.titre: Telework Yotabanashi
oeuvres.synopsis: Nokoru Mitsuhashi, un ingénieur système travaillant pour une entreprise peu scrupuleuse, a amélioré sa qualité de vie en introduisant le télétravail. Alors qu'il aménage l'intérieur de sa chambre et s'investit davantage sur son balcon, il fait la connaissance de sa voisine, Natsu Izumi, une étudiante diplômée. C'est l'histoire de la rencontre entre un homme et sa future femme grâce au télétravail, et de comment ils se sont mariés après de nombreux hauts et bas.

oeuvres.titre: Tengoku Daimakyou
oeuvres.synopsis: Dans un immense jardin coupé du monde, un groupe d'enfants jouit d'une vie douce et d'insouciance, protégé par des scientifiques. Le monde extérieur leur est inconnu mais certains d'entre eux se questionnent : qu'y a-t-il au-delà des murs de leur paradis ? Pendant ce temps, dans un Japon dévasté par un mystérieux cataclysme, Maru et Kiruko, deux adolescents de la génération post-catastrophe, tentent de survivre dans un monde désolé peuplé de pillards et de monstres difformes. Leur objectif : atteindre "le Paradis".

oeuvres.titre: Tenkuu no Shiro o Moratta no de Isekai de Tanoshiku Asobitai
oeuvres.synopsis: Un ange fit une erreur qui provoqua la mort de Shiihara Daiki. Pour cacher cette erreur, il fut envoyé dans un monde différent. L’ange lui accorda un vœu en tant que payement pour qu’il garde cela secret. Daiki demanda pour un château céleste qui flotte dans le ciel sans hésitation. Soudainement, un château flottant apparut dans le nouveau monde, ce qui causa une confusion parmi les populations. Ils essayèrent de contacter Daiki de plusieurs manières. Un pays essaye de le voler de force, pendant qu’un autre tente d’être amis avec lui. Que va donc faire Daiki ? --- - Site officiel (anglais):

oeuvres.titre: Tenohira Kaitaku Mura de Isekai Kenkokuki ~Fueteku Yome-tachi to Nonbiri Mujintou Life~
oeuvres.synopsis: Kai, a sickly kid, wished for a lively normal life on his deathbed when he was suddenly reincarnated into another world. Not only the boy's wishes were fulfilled, he was also gifted an ability to be a god of his own little world at the back of his palm. Yet such bliss did not last long... Kai was abruptly separated from his loving adopted family and banished into an uninhabited island teeming with dangerous creatures. Using his ingenious wit and a help from a mysterious horned girl, Kai managed to survive and establish a small foothold with his army of cute stubby helpers. Watch as Kai tries t

oeuvres.titre: TenPuru
oeuvres.synopsis: That's right, I'll become a monk! Not knowing what to do with his worldly desires, Akagami Akemitsu aims to live a stoic life. However, the thick karmic blood flowing in him will not permit it!

oeuvres.titre: Tensei Goblin dakedo Shitsumon Aru?
oeuvres.synopsis: An ordinary office worker should have died in a traffic accident, but when he awoke he became a goblin. Goblins have a lifespan of only seven days. However, the hero who has been given the skill "Human 80 years" takes advantage of his longevity and takes over the skills of many goblins and even the demon king who is on the verge of destined life, and stands out in a different world. Weakest Race x Strongest Skill = The strongest fantasy is incomparable!

oeuvres.titre: Tensei Kenja no Isekai Life: Dai ni no Shokugyou o Ete, Sekai Saikyou ni Narimashita
oeuvres.synopsis: Yuji Sano, employé d'une "entreprise noire", est invoqué vers un autre alors qu'il était en train de travailler chez lui. Dans ce nouveau monde, il obtient la profession de "dresseur" de monstre, une profession qui rend le travail d'aventurier difficile. Cependant, grâce aux nombreux Slimes qu'il a dressés, il obtient une seconde profession, celle de "Sage", après qu'ils aient lu de nombreux livres magiques pour lui. Yuji a alors acquis un immense pouvoir dont il ne semble pas être conscient. Insoucieusement, il est en voie de devenir le plus puissant être de ce monde!

oeuvres.titre: Tensei Kizoku no Isekai Boukenroku ~Jichou wo Shiranai Kamigami no Shito~
oeuvres.synopsis: Shiina Kazuya, the protagonist of the story was killed by a stranger in front of a convenience store when he tried to protect two young girls escaping from the stranger who is trying to stab them. The girls fall and are too overcome with fear to get up and continue running away. When Shiina Kazuya awakens he realizes that he was reincarnated as the young noble Cain von Silford, the third son of an aristocrat (Margrave Garm Von Silford) and his second wife (Sarah) in a world filled with sword and sorcery. Prior to the age of ten Cain grew up in the Gracia Territory surrounded by gods that don't

oeuvres.titre: Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru: Jakushou Ryouchi o Uketsuida node, Yuushuu na Jinzai o Fuyashiteitara, Saikyou Ryouchi ni Natteta
oeuvres.synopsis: After being reincarnated, Ars Louvent is supposed to live in a different world as a weak aristocrat. Both his physical strength and intelligence were mediocre in both worlds, but here he naturally possessed a skill called "Appraisal" that allowed him to see the potential of any person. By gathering talented people by his side, Ars uses this "Appraisal" skill to transform his weak territory into the strongest one! But the road ahead of him won't be so simple.

oeuvres.titre: Tensei Kyuuketsuki-san wa Ohirune ga Shitai
oeuvres.synopsis: A polite and lethargic boy was reincarnated in another world as a vampire bishoujo. In this world of swords and magic, this protagonist who was reborn replete with all kinds of cheat powers was searching for one thing??! "Three meals a day, snacks and an afternoon nap, I guess." Are you really the protagonist!? And thus begins the fantasy comedy of a vampire looking for the ideal moocher lifestyle.

oeuvres.titre: Tensei Oujo wa Kyou mo Hata wo Tatakioru
oeuvres.synopsis: I was reborn as a princess in the world of an otome game, with memories of my past life. Wait, what? I'm the heroine's love rival? No way! oeuvres.titre: Tensei Shita Kuukan Mahoutsukai wa Shoutai Kakushite Medachitai!
oeuvres.synopsis: "With this power, couldn't I become a mysterious mage who stands out while no one knows who he is?" Higashiyama Touri is reincarnated and granted the ultimate talent for a rare and special type of magic, "Dimensional Magic" by God himself. Dreaming of becoming the cool, enigmatic powerhouse whose name spreads through whispered rumors while he enjoys a quiet drink at the bar, Touri decides to act out his fantasy. oeuvres.titre: Tensei Shitara Dainana Ouji datta node, Kimama ni Majutsu o Kiwamemasu
oeuvres.synopsis: Prince Lloyd wasn’t always a prince…in fact, his previous life is one he remembers perfectly: he was a sorcerer, of sorts. So when he was forced to reincarnate, he decided to continue his studies, prince of the realm or no! But his new life has its own sets of challenges…including being a 10-year-old! What’s the 7th prince/sorcerer to do?! *Source: Kodansha Comics*

oeuvres.titre: Tensei Shitara Dragon no Tamago datta: Ibara no Dragon Road
oeuvres.synopsis: **A fantasy isekai adventure about a man who has to restart life…as an egg?!** In a world full of dangerous monsters, our unnamed protagonist finds himself reborn at the very bottom of the food chain as an immobile, powerless egg. Even just hatching will require leveling up by fighting monsters–the same monsters who’d love to eat him as a snack. But with the help of the mysterious voice in his head, he’s determined to grow into the most powerful creature in the world! *Source: Seven Seas Entertainment* **Note:** When the manga initially began, it used the light novel's “Saikyou Igai Mezasa nee

oeuvres.titre: Tensei Shitara Ken deshita
oeuvres.synopsis: When he realized it, the protagonist was in another world and had become a sword that was stabbed on an altar in a great plain, crowded with devil beast. The world he was in had a game like system; HP, MP, Strength, Vitality, Agility, Intelligence, Dexterity, Titles and Equipment. Following his instinct as a living sword, he traveled to find the one who could be his wielder, until he met with a cat girl that was about to be attacked by a bear type devil beast.

oeuvres.titre: Tensei Shitara Slime datta Ken
oeuvres.synopsis: The ordinary Mikami Satoru found himself dying after being stabbed by a slasher. It should have been the end of his meager 37 years, but he found himself deaf and blind after hearing a mysterious voice. He had been reincarnated into a slime! oeuvres.titre: Tensei Shite High Elf ni Narimashitaga, Slow Life wa 120-nen de Akimashita - Highelf with a Long Life
oeuvres.synopsis: Life in the Great Pulha Woodlands is the very definition of stillness and tranquility—and Aesir's had enough of it! That's right. oeuvres.titre: The Advanced Player of the Tutorial Tower
oeuvres.synopsis: Après avoir été enfermé pendant 12 ans dans la tour tutoriel, le monde me considérait comme un expert. oeuvres.titre: The Archmage Returns After 4000 Years
oeuvres.synopsis: Il redeviendra le maître des étoiles ! Dans ce monde où les dieux règnent et les humains sont doués de magie, le plus grand mage est condamné aux enfers après avoir défier les dieux. Des milliers d’années plus tard, il est réincarné dans le corps d'un jeune ado de l'académie de magie qui vient de mettre fin à ses jours après de longues années de brimades… Par le biais de cette nouvelle vie, il est prêt à prendre sa revanche !

oeuvres.titre: The Beginning After the End
oeuvres.synopsis: Le Roi Grey a une force, une richesse et un prestige inégalés dans un monde gouverné par l'aptitude martiale. Cependant, la solitude s'approche de près derrière ceux ayant de grands pouvoirs. Sous l'apparence glamour d'un Roi puissant se cache la carapace de l'homme, dépourvue de volonté et de but. Réincarné dans un nouveau monde rempli de monstres et de magie, le Roi a une seconde chance de revivre sa vie. Cependant, corriger les erreurs de sa précédente vie ne sera pas sa seule tâche. Sous la paix et la prospérité de ce nouveau monde se cache une menace sous-jacente remettant en question tou

oeuvres.titre: The Beloved Little Princess
oeuvres.synopsis: La Grande Archimage du royaume d'Archus tombe malade et décide de s'endormir en pensant aller mieux le lendemain. Mais à son réveil, elle se retrouve dans le corps de la petite princesse du royaume voisin d'Hyperion. Or selon la prophétie, elle est l'enfant tant attendue qui apportera gloire et prospérité. Depuis, elle est dorlotée et adulée par sa nouvelle famille un peu trop protectrice. Arrivera-t-elle à redevenir la Grande Archimage qu'elle était autrefois? --- L’archimage qui a régné sur un royaume magique. Un jour, elle renaît comme la plus jeune fille de l’empire! «Je vais simplement jo

oeuvres.titre: The Hero Laughs While Walking the Path of Vengeance a Second Time
oeuvres.synopsis: Revenge. But a single word defines Kaito Ukei’s second chance at life. After being mercilessly betrayed and murdered by his so-called comrades, he goes back in time to the day he met the princess who ultimately double-crossed him. But killing her isn’t enough - he wants to revel in every second of her agony as he looks her in the eye and robs her of all she holds dear. Her debt is the first to be repaid, though it shall not be the last. And by the time he’s finished, he will bathe in the blood of every last traitor who dared to cross him… --- [Original Web Novel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n852

oeuvres.titre: The Lady and the Beast
oeuvres.synopsis: Après une vie ponctuée de massacres et de trahisons, l'impératrice Martina se réincarne dans le corps d'Astina, de longues années plus tard. Seulement, cette fois aussi, sa vie ne sera pas de tout repos, puisqu'après que leur père a fait faillite, la sœur d'Astina est mariée de force à l'archiduc Atalenta, un homme victime d'une terrible malédiction le transformant en monstre. Astina décide alors de prendre la place de la jeune Kanna, et affronte sans mal la bête terrifiante qu'est devenu l'archiduc. Elle n'en reste pas moins surprise d'arriver à gérer la situation avec tant de facilité, et l'

oeuvres.titre: The Max Level Hero Strikes Back
oeuvres.synopsis: Struck by an enemy’s arrow, the powerless Prince Davey O’Rowane falls into a coma. His soul travels to a place where the greatest of the great gather — the honorable Hall of Heroes. There, a thousand years pass as Davey undergoes excruciating training under their watchful eyes to become a hero too strong for his own good. Now back to his timeline and his kingdom, he’s wide awake and the enemies hiding in the king’s court better be prepared - the prince they had dismissed is now their biggest threat!

oeuvres.titre: The New Gate
oeuvres.synopsis: The New Gate — an online game transformed into a life-and-death struggle for its players. Thanks to the valiant efforts of Shin, the most powerful of them all, an end to the game and freedom for everyone seemed within reach. But just moments after Shin defeats the game's final boss, he finds himself bathed in an unknown light and transported some 500 years into the future of the in-game world!

oeuvres.titre: The Precious Sister of the Villainous Grand Duke
oeuvres.synopsis: I became the sister of the villain, who shed no blood or tears in a war-ridden novel! I thought I was born again as the youngest daughter of a noble family, but I'm the little sister of a villain who's only being used! A baby's body too fragile to survive in the Lagrange household, a brutal family that makes children fight for successors… I've decided to stick to the villain in order to live! I need you to be my guardian until I run away from here. Raise me, villain! ---

oeuvres.titre: The Reincarnated Evil Dragon
oeuvres.synopsis: Cette histoire est à propos d'un homme étant mort dans un accident de voiture causé par un couple. Alors qu'il pensait que c'était la fin, il se réincarna dans un monde fantaisiste.. Mais pas en humain, mais en un dragon extrêment puissant, dû à sa puissance, il s'ennuya, car il battait tout le monde, mise à part une guerrière extrêment déterminée qui revenait à chacune de ses défaites, alors qu'un jour, il était avec elle, il mangea une sorte de chose spéciale lui faisant prendre forme humaine. Désormais, il se rend dans une ville avec la guerrière déterminée.

oeuvres.titre: The Skeleton Soldier Failed to Defend the Dungeon
oeuvres.synopsis: Découvrez le Soldat Squelette, le frêle mais loyal combattant, se battant pour protéger sa maîtresse, Dame Succube. Son rêve d'une vie paisible à ses côtés est réduit à néant le jour où ils sont tous les deux brutalement assassinés par un groupe de guerriers. Mais ce qui allait être une fin tragique se révèle être en fait un nouveau commencement : le Soldat Squelette se réveille de nouveau... 20 ans plus tôt ! oeuvres.titre: The Sorcerer King of Destruction and the Golem of the Barbarian Queen
oeuvres.synopsis: A young man suddenly awakens in the middle of an open field, with only his lame pajamas as company. Apparently he was summoned as a "Sorcerer King of Destruction" to destroy the world. What the Hell?! But nothing's going to happen by staying depressed, so why not make a golem with earth magic! And then…? Exploring another world with the strongest inhuman partner!

oeuvres.titre: The Soulless Duchess
oeuvres.synopsis: Je suis morte misérablement, le jour où j’ai découvert la vérité. La vérité, c’est que mon fiancé avait un amant caché et c’était mon propre cousin. Le lendemain de mon 20e anniversaire, un miracle s’est produit. A partir de là, j’ai décidé de ne plus croire à l’amour. Je veux avoir une relation sans aucune condition et sans sentiments superficiels tels que l’amour. «Duke Agentine, voulez-vous m’épouser?» Cette proposition n’était rien de plus qu’un mariage pour garder les apparences et sans amour impliqué.

oeuvres.titre: The Taming of the Tyrant
oeuvres.synopsis: God gave me a chance to relive my life. Before my rebirth, I'd been used for the past 400 years as the empire's sword. And so, I swore to destroy the empire. I found the young prince of the country and became his teacher. I taught him how to become a tyrant and asked for the country. "I will do as the lady wishes." He conquered the whole empire for me, and I ran away. "I came to take you, Charlize Ronan," Dylan had become a perfect tyrant and searched the entire empire for me. oeuvres.titre: The Twins' New Life
oeuvres.synopsis: En renaissant en tant que prince et princesse d'un monde féérique, Arienne Yuriana et son frère jumeau, Arhen, auraient dû mener une vie luxueuse... Mais au lieu de palais somptueux, d'aventures magiques et de servants attentionnés, les jumeaux sont abandonnés par l'empereur et doivent vivre avec leur mère violente dans un château en ruines rempli de servantes cruelles. Cependant, lorsqu'un étrange accident les laisse sans tuteur, leur père refait surface et leur annonce qu'il veut qu'ils viennent vivre au palais! Lorsqu'ils se retrouvent soudainement jetés dans cet univers royal dont ils igno

oeuvres.titre: The Villainess Is a Marionette
oeuvres.synopsis: "Beauty cannot be real power." Cayena, the Imperial Princess, was known as the most beautiful woman in the Empire. She was a woman who knew nothing but evil and luxury. "…Sister, you're going to make me the emperor?" "In exchange, give me freedom." She had to change things before she became *that* Cayena. --- I woke up as Kayena Hill, the novel’s villainess, praised as the greatest beauty in the empire. Who knew that he

oeuvres.titre: The Villainess Turns the Hourglass
oeuvres.synopsis: With the marriage of her prostitute mother to the Count, Aria’s status in society skyrocketed immediately. After leading a life of luxury, Aria unfairly meets death because of her sister Mielle’s schemes. And right before she dies, she sees an hourglass fall as if it were a fantasy. And just like that, she was miraculously brought back to the past. “I want to become a very elegant person, just like my sister, Mielle.” In order to face the villainess, she must become an even more wicked villainess. This was the new path Aria chose to take revenge on Mielle who murdered both her and her mother.

oeuvres.titre: The Villainess with Special Circumstances
oeuvres.synopsis: Pour diverses raisons, Laetitia, fille du duc de Charrière, a tout fait pour que ses fiançailles avec le prince soient rompues. Ses efforts furent récompensés lorsque le prince annonça furieusement l'annulation de leur engagement. Mais alors qu'elle pensait que tout était réglé… un incident lui fit se rappeler de sa vie antérieure! Avec les souvenirs de sa vie passée au japon en tant qu'infirmière, elle est déterminée à vivre tranquillement au côtés de son compagnon favori, l'alcool! Mais pour certaines raisons, elle continue d'être entrainée d'incidents en incidents!

oeuvres.titre: This Girl Is a Little Wild
oeuvres.synopsis: As he was being defeated, the Demon King used the last of his strength to curse Sir Roel, the legendary captain of the Holy Knights, into the body of a weak girl. Roel — who was a woman to begin with! — tired of her former life and unable to return to her original body, decides to live a luxurious life as Sila Epheria, the noble daughter whose soul got swapped with hers. Things don't go according to plan when her new family puts her in danger, forcing her to find a way to prove her true identity… Will Roel/Sila be able to live a quiet life as she wishes? oeuvres.titre: Toaru Ossan no VRMMO Katsudouki
oeuvres.synopsis: Typical company employee Tanaka Daichi (38 years old, single) loves games and plays a new type of VRMMO called "One More Free Life Online" under the username "Earth". Inside this free world he chose several skills that are generally regarded as useless. Be it wasting time crafting potions, cooking up pointlessly tasty food, or hunting monsters with some absurd weapon he crafted, he simply enjoys playing the game.

oeuvres.titre: Tokidoki Bosotto Russia-go de Dereru Tonari no Alya-san
oeuvres.synopsis: "И на меня тоже обрати внимание..." Alya, the incomparably beautiful silver-haired girl in the next seat over, occasionally mumbles to herself in Russian. oeuvres.titre: Tokimori-san ga Muboubi desu!!
oeuvres.synopsis: Tokimori-san is a beautiful and successful woman. But when she's off the job, she tends to be a bit absent-minded! Living together with the charming Tokimori-san always makes me nervous!

oeuvres.titre: Tomo-chan wa Onna no ko!
oeuvres.synopsis: Tomo Aizawa was able to successfully confess to her crush Junichirou Kubota. There is only one problem: He just sees her as his buddy. He thought that she was a boy until they went to middle school together, because her grade school was in a different school district.

oeuvres.titre: Tonari no Furi-san ga Tonikaku Kowai
oeuvres.synopsis: Ordinary High-schooler Taira Namito, who is ordinary inside, unknowingly becomes the target of the female delinquent-looking girl Furi Youko, a pure maiden at heart, who sits next to him.

oeuvres.titre: Tonari no Neko to Koi Shirazu
oeuvres.synopsis: Sa voisine a tout d'un chat... C'est la rentrée scolaire. Seno, un jeune lycéen, découvre que sa voisine de classe est pour le moins particulière. Elle passe toute la journée à dormir sur son bureau, ce qui n'est pas sans faire rager et inquiéter son professeur... Celui-ci demande alors à Seno de se rapprocher d'elle et de tout faire pour la maintenir éveillée pendant les cours. Un défi des plus difficiles pour ce garçon très timide et réservé. oeuvres.synopsis: "I dyed my hair black for you... so notice me." Shimizu-san, the delinquent highschool girl who sits next to Hondo with her newly-dyed hair, gradually lowered her voice, slightly blushed, and laid her face down on the desk. After that, when Daiki Hondo talked with his friend about how he wanted be with a girl who can cook, the next day Hondo ended up partnered with Shimizu-san in cooking class, even though she used to always skip class.
